notes.content: Hey there! This small patch fixes a number of typos in the Russian version of the game as well as the background slicing issue. An update for other languages is scheduled for later this week.

notes.title: Steam cards!
notes.content:
Improvements:
1. The glossary button no longer flickers ad infinitum. Now it stops doing that after 6 seconds.
2.  Minor fixes in the Russian text. 
3.  We've added trading cards, badges, emojis and profile backgrounds!

Thank you for supporting us and helping make the game better!
